headline_pain: Rates Are High. Rent Is Higher.
primary_text: "Interest rates make me nervous about committing to a purchase right now." You know what should make you more nervous? Paying $40k+ a year in rent with nothing to show for it. Rates are a cost of borrowing. Rent is a cost of never owning. Dozens of small businesses in Melbourne's west have already crunched the numbers and chosen ownership. Off-the-plan warehouses in Truganina, minutes from Princes Freeway and West Gate Tunnel. Deposit now, settle on completion. Your accountant will thank you.
description: Rent costs you $40k+ per year forever — a mortgage actually ends.
